title: kv-prefetch-aware-batching-with-sparse-scratch-allocator
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: In production workloads with long chat histories the KV cache dominates transient GPU workspace allocations and forces arena growth during batching spikes. Motivation: Reduce peak GPU footprint while preserving latency SLOs and steady-state throughput. Summary: Introduces a KV-prefetch hotset buffer and a sparse scratch allocator to avoid inflating the global arena during continuous batching. The hotset prefetcher tracks request-level KV hotness and pre-populates a compact per-device hotset capable of serving the majority of cache hits without expanding the scratch arena. The sparse scratch allocator exposes a lightweight free-list for short-lived activation fragments and returns large contiguous ranges back to the arena quickly, reducing fragmentation. Key changes: 1) runtime/kv: prefetch_hotset component with heuristics for prefix/predictive prefetch and bounded memory cap. 2) runtime/allocator: sparse_scratch_allocator that coexists with existing arena and supports deferred materialization for checkpointed activations. 3) scheduler: integrate prefetch decisions into continuous_batcher so requests in the same batch can share prefetched KV and avoid duplicate allocations. 4) observability: new metrics for kv_hotset_hit_ratio, scratch_frag_pct, and prefetch_evictions, plus a dashboard. Results: in internal LLaMA-2-13B quantized chat trace we saw peak GPU RSS drop ~18% (24.6GB -> 20.1GB), 95th latency unchanged within noise, throughput +3% under steady batching, and per-token cost reduction ~12%. Compatibility: falls back to existing arena+kv behavior when hotset cap is exceeded or prefetch disabled. Rollout: feature-flagged, opt-in per-customer; staged rollout with smoke tests and perf canary on dedicated pools. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] perf regression run, [x] docs, [x] observability. Related: ENG-863 describes requirements for KV costing and ENG-874 is follow-up for multi-GPU hotset federated eviction.

review_comments: Ethan Park (2025-11-03): Nice decomposition. Two asks: add a stress test for prefetch backpressure and make hotset cap an explicit config parameter at runtime. Maya: added cap flag and stress test in continuous_batcher_test.cc (see commits).

Luca Moretti (2025-11-05): How does this interact with activation checkpointing and deferred materialization? Suggest adding a note in allocator to avoid double-free of deferred fragments. Maya: added guard and unit test covering checkpointed activations.

Aisha Rahman (2025-11-07): Observability looks good. Can we emit a synthetic prefetch in the perf harness to detect regressions? Maya: added benchmark variant that toggles prefetch and records hit ratio.
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky on first run -> rerun -> pass
perf-regression-check: pass (no regression on canonical traces)
merge_details: Merged via squash on 2025-11-10 by Aisha Rahman. Merge commit message: "kv-prefetch-aware-batching + sparse scratch allocator: reduce peak GPU memory and stabilize arena growth. Closes ENG-863."
release_notes: Introduce KV prefetch hotset and sparse scratch allocator. Peak GPU memory reduced ~18% on targeted workloads. Feature is behind runtime feature flag 'kv_prefetch_hotset' and can be toggled per-deployment. No breaking changes expected; falls back to previous behavior when disabled.
metrics_summary: Per-token cost: -12% (measured on quantized LLaMA-2-13B trace)
testing_summary: Unit tests added for allocator and hotset eviction. Integration tests exercise prefetch across batch boundaries. Perf harness includes a regression profile comparing baseline vs prefetched runs. Benchmarks executed on dedicated gpu-canary pool; canary passed.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: prefetch may increase memory if mis-tuned. Mitigation: hard cap config and auto-disable when prefetch_evictions spike.
Risk: interaction with multi-GPU kv sharding may cause duplicate prefetches. Mitigation: guarded sync path and eviction tokens to de-duplicate.
Risk: allocator fragmentation regressions. Mitigation: allocator exposes diagnostic metrics and fast fallback to global arena.
rollout_plan: Feature is behind 'kv_prefetch_hotset' flag. Stage 1: internal canary on dedicated pool (5 servers) for 48h. Stage 2: opt-in customer beta with contractual workloads. Stage 3: gradual enable on non-sensitive hosted traffic with traffic steering and perf alarms. Full rollout requires KPI: kv_hotset_hit_ratio>0.6 and no latency SLO violations for 24h.
